description: A direct-to-consumer retailer running its own catalog, inventory, and fulfillment from order placement through delivery confirmation.
note: Structure only. Sample orders, prices, and customer names are not in this file.

roles.name: Operations director
roles.description: Owns end-to-end fulfillment performance, carrier relationships, and SLA commitments.

roles.name: Order manager
roles.description: Processes incoming orders, validates payments, and sets warehouse priority.

roles.name: Warehouse lead
roles.description: Directs pick-and-pack, owns inventory accuracy, and oversees outbound shipments.

roles.name: Customer support lead
roles.description: Handles delivery inquiries, manages returns, and resolves post-shipment exceptions.

roles.name: Merchandising manager
roles.description: Owns the catalog — what is listed, how it is priced, and when it goes live.

processes.name: Order fulfillment
processes.description: Placement through delivery confirmation, across catalog, inventory, and fulfillment.

steps.name: Receive order
steps.description: Ingest the order, validate line items, and confirm the SKUs are sellable.

steps.name: Verify payment
steps.description: Confirm authorization; hold or decline anything the processor flags.

steps.name: Reserve inventory
steps.description: Hold stock at the fulfilling location and trigger replenishment if it goes short.

steps.name: Pick & pack
steps.description: Retrieve the items, verify quantities, and package for the carrier.

steps.name: Dispatch shipment
steps.description: Generate the label, hand off to the carrier, and publish tracking to the order.

steps.name: Confirm delivery
steps.description: Verify carrier confirmation, close the order, and open the post-purchase follow-up.

rules.name: Payment clears before stock moves
rules.description: No stock is reserved until payment authorization has cleared.

rules.name: Only warehouse dispatches
rules.description: Dispatch is the warehouse’s call. Support can ask; it cannot ship.

rules.name: Returns are supports to approve
rules.description: Only support authorizes returns, so refund exposure has one owner.

rules.name: Catalog goes live through merchandising
rules.description: Nothing reaches the storefront without merchandising publishing it.

systems.name: Fulfillment worker
systems.description: Runs the pick, pack, and dispatch steps against carrier APIs.
